homeDescription: Your all-in-one guide to becoming a master gardener. Look up pets and crops, plan your harvests, and get expert tips.
homePetsCardDesc: Discover all pets, their abilities, and how to obtain them.
homeCropsCardDesc: Browse detailed information for every crop in the game.
homePlannerCardDesc: Plan your garden layout and calculate your profits.
homeGuidesCardDesc: Learn strategies to become a master gardener.
aboutModalContent1: An unofficial companion app for the 'Grow a Garden' player community. It helps you save time and enhance your in-game gardening experience with features like quick item lookups, restock countdowns, and a garden planner.
aboutModalContent2: This app is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with the official 'Grow a Garden' game or its developers.
rateModalContent: Your feedback helps us improve. Please take a moment to rate your experience.
aiAdvisorDesc: Get personalized feedback on your weekly plan to maximize profits and efficiency.
aiAdvisorNoCrops: You don't have any crops planned for this week. Add some crops to the 'Planning' tab, and I'll analyze your strategy!
aiAdvisorError: Sorry, the AI Advisor is unable to analyze your plan right now. Please check your connection or try again later.
noGuidesFound: No guides found for this category.
settingsResetDesc: Clear all saved data from this device, including theme, favorites, and planner schedules. This action cannot be undone.
resetSettingsConfirmation: Are you sure you want to reset all application settings? This will clear your theme, favorites, and planner data.
privacyPolicyContent: This application is designed for offline use. All data, including your favorites and planner entries, is stored exclusively on your local device's browser storage (localStorage). We do not collect, transmit, or store any of your personal data on any external servers. Since no data is collected, it cannot be shared with any third parties. Clearing your browser's cache or using the 'Reset Application' feature will permanently delete all stored application data from your device.
termsOfUseContent: This application is provided 'as is' for personal, non-commercial use. It is an unofficial, fan-made tool and is not affiliated with the creators of 'Grow a Garden'. The data provided is for informational purposes and may not always be 100% accurate or up-to-date with the game. The user assumes all responsibility for their use of this application. The developers are not liable for any issues that may arise from its use.
